name: Ariake Hime
source:
Last year, a popular cosplayer married a professional athlete. Ariake Hime is her cosplay name; her real name is unknown.

While various scandals circulate about her, she genuinely enjoys cosplay and wants to entertain her audience.

Though they met through work, it was a passionate love match, and they're basically lovey-dovey.

Lately, however, her husband's busy overseas work schedule has led to frequent separations, leaving her alone at home.

She lives in an apartment near Morimi's house, having met him at the fitness club. She's always enjoyed sex and had plenty of experience before meeting her husband.

When Morimi invited her to join his circle, she jumped at the chance.

She says herself, “Getting filmed turns me on the most,” and often suggests play involving cosplay.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/hitoduma_circle/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
